# Trusted by over 30% of Fortune 100 and hundreds of other large, global enterprises

Public and private sector organizations trust our People Insights Platform to illuminate their employee experience so they can enable their people and business to thrive.

## Know Your Data is Safe

![headshot 8](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/platform/survey-multi-rater-feedback-photo.jpg?width=50&height=51&name=survey-multi-rater-feedback-photo.jpg)![Continuous listening](https://go.perceptyx.com/hubfs/platform/screenshots/screenshot-survey-continuous-listening.svg)

### Continuous listening

For over 20 years, Perceptyx has been safely stewarding the data of many of the world’s largest organizations, earning several of the industry’s top security certifications. We are proudly ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II compliant and we provide a dedicated instance of our platform for U.S. federal government customers, authorized by the U.S. Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program [(FedRAMP)](https://marketplace.fedramp.gov/#!/product/perceptyx-insights-platform-formerly-waggl?sort=productName&productNameSearch=Perceptyx). With these gold-standard authorizations covering hundreds of policies and procedures, our public and private sector customers can be assured their data is safe with Perceptyx.

## Rely on Our Certifications and Compliance

Hundreds of global organizations use our enterprise-grade Perceptyx platform as the foundation of their employee feedback strategy. We provide our public and private sector customers with an unwavering commitment to security and data privacy, validated by our adherence to the industry's most stringent frameworks:

- **Global Security Certifications:** Annual certifications under ISO 27001:2022 demonstrating our commitment to information security, cloud security, and personal data protection.
- **SOC 2 Type 2 Attestation:** Independent audits verifying the effectiveness of our controls related to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.
- **Global Privacy Compliance:** Full adherence to key data privacy regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
- **Data Transfer Certification:** Certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework to ensure lawful and secure international data transfers.
- **U.S. Government Authorization:** A dedicated platform instance authorized by the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) for use by federal agencies.
